planets.name: TOI-1670 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1670 with a 11-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1670 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1670. Its orbit and size follow Tran et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
